newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean expects Hyundai smelter decision.
newsitem.headline: Chilean expects Hyundai smelter decision.

text.p: South Korean industrial firm Hyundai Corp should take a decision on whether to go ahead with a big copper smelter project in Chile in the first half of this year, the head of the Chilean national mining association (Sonami) said Tuesday.
Sonami president Hernan Hoschild told reporters that Sonami had delivered a study on possible smelter projects in Chile which Hyundai had commissioned and that the firm would soon take its decision.
Sonami said last year that Hyundai was looking to build a smelting and refining complex with a capacity of to produce about 400,000 tonnes of copper a year which would cost between $300-$600 million.
There was also a possibility Hyundai might opt to form a joint venture to expand existing facilities, instead of building from scratch, Sonami said.
